purpose: Local, source-traceable retrieval cards for offline evaluation; not a validated protocol

evidence_for: blood spurts or gushes in a jet
blood quickly soaks through the dressing
evidence_against: it is reported that the hemorrhage has stopped
cards.action_scope: In case of severe hemorrhage, urgently involve a person nearby and the person responsible for medical assistance; direct pressure on the wound, without delaying action for the sake of chat.
do_not_infer: Absence of numbness excludes vessel injury

source.title: American Red Cross: Life-Threatening External Bleeding

ask_if_unknown: Is there repeated vomiting or increasing pain
cards.action_scope: Stop work, report to the medical aid responsible person and observe symptom changes; urgent evaluation is needed if alarming signs are present.
do_not_infer: Absence of external blood excludes trauma

source.title: NICE NG232: Head injury assessment and early management

evidence_for: abdominal pain or cramps after suspicious food
ask_if_unknown: is the pain worsening or localized
cards.action_scope: Clarify symptoms and signs of dehydration; do not declare the pathogen or product as the cause only after the interval following eating.
do_not_infer: specific pathogen by time of symptom onset
any abdominal pain means foodborne infection

evidence_for: dyspnea occurring simultaneously with a decrease in SpO₂
evidence_against: repeated qualitative readings returned to the original level after a single spike
cards.action_scope: Repeat correct measurement, assess symptoms and environment; persistently low values require prompt evaluation by the responsible party.
do_not_infer: cause of low SpO₂ from a single pulse oximeter
a single 91% followed by 97–99% indicates persistent hypoxemia

cards.name_ru: Change in vision; risk of SANS
evidence_for: reproducible worsening of repeated vision tests relative to the individual's original series during flight
evidence_against: stable comparable test results and absence of complaints
ask_if_unknown: are the device, distance, and lighting the same
cards.action_scope: Record the dynamics and forward for in-person evaluation via an available procedure; the screen test detects a change but does not confirm SANS.
do_not_infer: SANS based on one screen test
eye structure density based on subjective complaints

source.title: NASA Human Research Roadmap: SANS Risk

cards.name_ru: Risk of bone changes during flight
evidence_for: long flight and reduction in available load
reduction in strength/function with comparable tests
ask_if_unknown: is there an initial and repeated bone examination
cards.action_scope: Note the risk factor and functional test status; do not equate steps or complaints with bone mineral density measurement.
do_not_infer: quantitative loss of bone mass from the number of steps

source.title: NASA Human Research Roadmap: Bone Fracture Risk

evidence_for: reduced training load and complaints of weakness
evidence_against: stable functional series under comparable conditions
ask_if_unknown: what is the individual initial test
are the conditions and method comparable
cards.action_scope: Compare individual function and training history; differentiate between muscular risk and confirmed disease.
do_not_infer: muscle mass reduction only by number of steps

source.title: NASA Human Research Roadmap: Reduced Fitness Risk

evidence_for: personal dosimetry or registered radiation event
evidence_against: no registered exposure in available data; this does not prove absence of exposure
ask_if_unknown: was there an event and when
what is the context of protection
cards.action_scope: Compare registered dose and event with specific mission rules; do not guess dose by symptoms.
do_not_infer: radiation sickness from fatigue or headache

evidence_for: reduction of sleep relative to personal series
evidence_against: stable sufficient series and absence of daytime complaints
ask_if_unknown: how many days does the change last
is there daytime sleepiness and change in schedule
cards.action_scope: Describe the dynamics of sleep and schedule, propose an assessment of workload and routine; do not mention apnea based on sleep duration.
do_not_infer: sleep apnea due to one short night
universal norm for any crew member

source.title: NASA Human Research Roadmap: Sleep, Circadian and Workload Risk

cards.name_ru: Elevated arterial blood pressure; possible hypertension
evidence_for: repeated correctly measured elevated BP on different days
evidence_against: single reading with stable personal series
ask_if_unknown: how many repetitions and on which days
cards.action_scope: Show the series, ground reference, and measurement conditions; do not automatically transfer the clinical classification for the astronaut.
do_not_infer: persistent hypertension based on one measurement
